chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

In the case of a man who had a wife under him, then he divorced her, and then he died before her waiting period ended, he said: 'She observes the longer of the two periods, the waiting period of one whose husband has died.'

key_terms.أَبْعَدَ الْأَجَلَيْنِ: The longer of the two periods
key_terms.عِدَّةُ: Waiting period (iddah) after divorce or death

ai.seo_question: What is the waiting period for a divorced woman if her husband dies before her divorce waiting period ends?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the jurisprudential principle of *taraddud* (ambiguity) in the status of a divorced woman whose husband dies during her waiting period. The Imam instructs her to observe the longer of the two periods—four months and ten days—to ensure the validity of her transition to a new marriage, reflecting the Shia emphasis on caution in personal status laws. This ruling underscores the importance of securing the lineage and rights of the woman when the cause of death occurs after the divorce pronouncement but before the period's conclusion.
